description: Unit test class for LocationValidator, verifying validation logic for Location objects in OpenMRS.

classes.name: LocationValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for LocationValidator, containing multiple test cases for validation logic.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Location's name is null or empty.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredAndRetireReasonIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if a retired Location has no retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldSetRetiredToFalseIfRetireReasonIsNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that a Location marked as retired without a retire reason gets its retired status set to false.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Confirms that a Location with valid data passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfRetiredLocationIsGivenRetiredReason
methods.description: Validation passes when a retired Location has a retire reason.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfParentLocationCreatesALoop
methods.description: Tests detection of cyclical parentLocation references.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfLocationNameAlreadyExist
methods.description: Checks that duplicate Location names trigger validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Validates that all field lengths are within allowed limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests validation errors for fields with excessive length.
